item.title: TRUSTY FLASHPOINT: NOW MARTIN SEES RED
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL saw red after Celtic’s second sending-off in three days. The Hoops’ interim manager watched Reo Hatate get his marching orders in the 2-2 Europa League draw with Bologna in Italy on Thursday evening. And it was Auston Trusty’s turn to be banished in another four-goal stalemate, this time against Hearts at Tynecastle yesterday. [...]

item.title: ‘I CAN OFFER A LITTLE BIT MORE,’ VOWS CVANCARA
item.description: TOMAS CVANCARA made his debut and lasted 65 minutes of Celtic’s 2-2 draw with Hearts at Tynecastle following a whirlwind three days for the towering striker. The Borussia Monchengladbach frontman agreed a short-term loan with an option to buy with the Hoops on Thursday and was pitched straight into the firing line for the team’s [...]

item.title: CELTIC IN £3m LINK
item.description: CELTIC have been linked with £3million-rated Norwegian midfielder Felix Horn Myhre. Martin O’Neill has until a week today to strengthen his squad as the clock ticks down towards the signing deadline. Bournemouth’s Mexico international right-back Julian Araujo and Borussia Monchengladbach’s Czech Republic forward Tomas Cvancara have both arrived on short-term loans as the champions’ only [...]

item.title: WATCH AGAIN: CELTIC’S CAPITAL STRIKES
item.description: BENJAMIN NYGREN flashed in an unstoppable free-kick for his thirteenth goal of the season in Celtic’s 2-2 draw with Hearts at Tynecastle yesterday. Unfortunately, the hosts drew level shortly after the turnaround with a header from former Hoops prospect Stuart Findlay. item.title: ‘I’M HERE,’ McGREGOR DISMISSES RODGERS REPORTS
item.description: CALLUM McGREGOR has dismissed speculation linking the Celtic skipper with a reunion with Brendan Rodgers in Saudi Arabia. Reports have suggested the 32-year-old midfielder could follow the former Hoops boss to Saudi Pro League outfit Al-Qadsiah.
